core_requests: P109: keep the original case of username entities (or an 'original' field): Hacker News ids are case-sensitive and the username normaliser lower-cases them; today only the exact-case profile URL input (news.ycombinator.com/user?id=<Id>) keeps the case.

P110 cond 3: per-source quota blocks (or a per-source 'units' cost) in the provider registry (P334): the youtube quota block is provider-wide, so keyless RSS/oEmbed requests count against the Data API 10,000 units/day and a quotaExceeded also stops RSS/oEmbed for the day.
P106 cond 1: a multi-entity batch hook for modules (several seeds of one case in one request); memory_lol.batch_url() builds <= 20-handle batches but the engine runs one entity per module run.
Shared safe-XML helper in v3lum/core (DOCTYPE/ENTITY refusal + size cap); p3g051_common.safe_xml_root duplicates what other batches (G10-1, G12-1) also wrote locally.
notes: All six proposals implemented as PASSIVE modules plus one correlation rule (p3g051_keybase_proof_corroborated, P104 cond 3) and a shared helper file (p3g051_common.py). Deferred (not a whole proposal): P105 cond 3 LIGHT variant mastodon_instance (LIGHT/ACTIVE classes are not added in this phase; backlogged until AR20). Seed providers keybase.json and hacker_news.json are referenced, not edited; new providers: algolia, youtube, memory_lol, arctic_shift, mastodon_ggmbh, hachyderm, vivaldi_social, fosstodon. The mastodon module derives hosts/sources from v3lum/data/mastodon/fediverse_instances.json (5 instances, resolver mastodon.social) and never contacts an unlisted instance; unlisted e-mail domains are SKIPPED without any WebFinger. Documented deviations: P110 requests part=snippet,statistics (cond 4 counts) on youtube.googleapis.com; P104 OK proofs are worded 'signed on or before <last identity change>' (no per-proof date without the sigchain); P104 BTC clause cannot fire with the cond 1 fields. memory_lol and reddit_archive are terms 'unknown' and default_enabled False (disabled in every licence profile until legal records a class). Synthetic fixtures (documented shapes, documentation values): keybase with-proofs/revoked, memory_lol non-empty, youtube Data API and consent redirect; all others are trimmed live captures of benign org/bot accounts. No provider has personal_data_review yet (legal_dpo item in the backlog). Full backlog: docs/backlog/p3-G05-1.md.
